Stil je lagan, cvjetan i travnat s voćnim rubom — čist za sipanje, ali doma je u Caipirinhi. Cachaça je brazilski rođak ruma: ista trska, ali svježi sok i vlastiti zakon.

The style is light, floral and grassy with a fruity edge — clean enough to sip, but at home in a Caipirinha. Cachaça is Brazil's cousin of rum: same cane, but fresh juice and its own law.

notes.en: Plantation Barbados 5 YO (40 %) — Barbados: tropsko voće, vanilija i hrast, lighter body. Neat or with a drop of water; keeps pace with a cigar.
